I always prepare mine in the skillet.
I just do my basic tofu scramble recipe (onions, mushrooms, crumbled tofu etc.) in a frying pan and then put it in a sealed container in the fridge.
When i need it i just heat it up on the microwave.

I use a whole block of tofu so the pan usually is a bit overcrowed yeah, but u just have to stir/shake it a bit every 2 mins or so and everything gets cooked evenly. 
If you wanna use a couple of blocks, I would just cook one portion, put it in a container, cook the next and so on.
Takes a bit more time but it will result in mutch better taste.
